# Write your MySQL query statement below
WITH RECURSIVE
    t AS (
        SELECT
            1 AS n
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            n + 1
        FROM t
        WHERE n < 100
    )
SELECT
    n AS ids
FROM t
WHERE
    n < (
        SELECT
            MAX(customer_id)
        FROM Customers
    )
    AND n NOT IN (
        SELECT
            customer_id
        FROM Customers
    );
title: Find the Missing IDs
